children: Overview
US bitcoin financial services firm's Q3 revenue fell and missed analyst expectations
Company posted a net loss for Q3 2026
Custody & Trading revenue rose 270%, driven by TikTok Shop gift card sales
Outlook
Fold Holdings expects to announce a financing partner for its Credit Card program soon
Company plans to add a credit facility partner to scale its Credit Card program
Fold says early demand for new balance products is running ahead of expectations
Result Drivers
TIKTOK SHOP SALES - Co said TikTok Shop became largest gift card and customer acquisition channel, driving a 270% increase in Custody & Trading revenue

NEW BALANCE PRODUCTS - Early demand for new balance products, including Fold Reserve and Lead Bank accounts, ran ahead of expectations with customers holding balances several times larger than average user, per CEO Will Reeves
PLATFORM EXPANSION - Launch of stored-value products and pass-through bitcoin buying enabled customers to hold funds and buy bitcoin directly from linked bank accounts
